name: Tom Aspinall

tale_of_tape.source: data/derived/fighters.json (77 in height, 78 in reach); 255 lb at the UFC 321 weigh-in (Oct 2025)

photo_coverage: Good. Frontal studio headshot and two full-body cutouts (ESPN), a right-side profile, a near-profile, a front weigh-in body shot (Oct 2025) and one 2026 daylight photo. No freely licensed photo of him was found on Wikimedia Commons (the English Wikipedia article has no image), so every file is reference-only.

face.shape: Long, rectangular face: noticeably taller than it is wide, with near-parallel sides from cheekbone to jaw. Lean, with little facial fat.
face.jaw: Wide and angular, with the jaw angles set well out under the ears. A long, straight jaw line runs down into a very thick, tattooed neck.
face.chin: Long and moderately projecting, hidden under a pointed goatee. In profile (03, 02) the chin and goatee reach slightly past the lower lip.
face.cheekbones: Moderate, not wide. The cheeks below them are flat to slightly hollow, with visible nasolabial lines.
face.brow_ridge: Moderately strong. The brows sit low on it, so the eyes look set back.
face.forehead: Medium-high and fairly upright, with a slight recession at the temples. The front hairline is fairly straight, with a curly forelock.

eyes.shape: Almond, medium-small, deep-set under low brows; mild under-eye bags
eyes.colour: light blue-grey (clear in the ESPN headshot)

eyebrows.shape: Fairly straight and low, dipping slightly at the outer ends; close to the upper lids

nose.tip: Rounded, of moderate size, angled slightly down
nose.fight_damage: None obvious; the line looks straight in front and profile views

face.mouth_lips: Medium width. Thin upper lip, slightly fuller lower lip. At rest the mouth sits straight or slightly downturned.

ears.cauliflower_ear: No obvious cauliflowering in the ESPN headshot or the profiles; the ears look smooth
ears.note: The ears stick out from the head (protruding), clearly visible in the frontal shots

face.notable_marks_scars: Light freckling across the nose and cheeks (ESPN headshot). Eye injury from UFC 321 (Oct 2025): there is no visible lasting scarring in the 2026 photo.

hair.style: Short skin fade on the sides and back. The top is left longer (curly) and pushed forward and up, with a loose curl falling on the forehead.
hair.length_note: About 0 to 0.3 cm on the sides; the top is about 5 to 7 cm and looked longer and messier in 2026 (07).
hair.colour_note: Dark brown, nearly black under arena and studio light (raw ESPN top-hair sample #201416; 07 crown in shadow #23170d). In daylight (07) the lit curls show medium-brown highlights (#64412f), so add a little brown variation rather than flat black.
hair.hairline: Fairly straight front hairline with mild temple recession
hair.texture: Curly on top when grown out (tight curls in the Oct 2025 ESPN headshot and weigh-in, looser and messier in 2026). In the older walkout and cage photos (01, 02) the top is cut short and reads as a textured crop with no visible curl.

facial_hair.detail: Thin moustache joined to a pointed chin beard (goatee) about 2 to 4 cm long, tapering to a point under the chin; the cheeks are shaved (2023-2025). In 2026 (07) it is a little fuller: the moustache still joins a short chin beard that now spreads slightly along the lower jaw toward the jaw angle, with light stubble above it; it is not a full cheek beard.
facial_hair.colour_note: Dark brown. The raw chin sample is #6c3832 because skin shows through; render the strands darker.
facial_hair.density: dense on the chin and moustache, none on the cheeks (2025)
facial_hair.shape: narrow vertical goatee (about 3 cm wide), pointed

skin.tone_hex_method: average of the cheek samples only (forehead samples sit on specular highlights in every photo); each sample is the median of the 25th-65th luma percentile pixels of the patch
skin.undertone: Neutral to pink. There is ruddy colour in the cheeks and nose under studio light.
skin.freckles_marks: Light freckles across the nose and cheeks; the neck and most of the upper body are covered with tattoos.
skin.note: The three photos disagree a lot (warm indoor 2026 vs cool arena light). The ESPN studio samples (#ec8f7f to #ee9181 cheek) are the most neutral; aim for a light skin with a pink undertone.

body.build: Very tall, big-framed heavyweight (196 cm, about 116 kg) with long limbs.
body.body_fat_note: Not shredded. The lower abdomen is smooth, with a small roll above the waistband and soft flanks. Upper abs show faintly only when flexing (04).
body.shoulders: Broad, rounded deltoids; the trapezius runs into a very thick neck
body.chest: Large, thick pectorals with a softer lower edge; heavily tattooed
body.arms: Big upper arms and thick forearms, covered in full sleeves
body.waist: Thick, but narrower than the shoulders: a mild taper rather than a sharp V
body.legs_calves: Long legs with solid thighs; calves medium-sized and fairly long
body.posture: Upright, relaxed shoulders, slight forward head carriage in the stance cutouts
body.notable: The neck is as wide as the jaw. With his height, the head looks normal-sized but the trunk is deep from front to back.

tattoos.where: neck (front and both sides) and upper sternum
tattoos.description: Dense black-and-grey neck piece (2025-2026): a spiral/galaxy motif with small stars at the centre of the throat, cloud shading wrapping the sides, the Taurus zodiac symbol (circle with horns, about 5 cm) on the right side of the neck (03, 07), and the Roman-numeral date IV.V.MMXIX across the top of the sternum. Absent in the Nov 2023 ESPN cutout and in photos 01 and 02, so it was added in 2024-2025.

tattoos.where: base of the right side of the neck, above the trapezius
tattoos.description: Small Roman-numeral script MCMXCIII (1993) running along the base of the neck (clear in 02, which predates the neck piece; not distinguishable in the lower-resolution 2025 photos)

tattoos.where: top of left shoulder near the collarbone

tattoos.description: Black-and-grey panorama: the Roman Colosseum and ruined buildings with flames or smoke, a Roman soldier/gladiator figure with spear and shield on the left pec, and a cloud/smoke band along the lower edge

Full sleeve. Outer shoulder and upper arm: black-and-grey Japanese-style dragon (2023 cutout). Inner upper arm: a colour koi (green body, red fins) with a blue peony and grey waves (Oct 2025 weigh-in, 04). Forearm: a black-and-grey serpent coiling from elbow to wrist. An older photo (01) also shows cursive script ('Pocket Full of ...') on the inner left forearm.

Full sleeve, reworked between 2023 and 2025. In 2023: solid black shading on the shoulder with tribal-style shapes, a palm tree and dotwork stars on the forearm. By Oct 2025: colour flowers (red/orange) at the top of the shoulder, a large black-and-grey skull/mask face on the outer upper arm, a teal-green koi with scales on the forearm, pink-purple peonies with green leaves on the inner forearm, a few lines of cursive script on the inner upper arm, a solid black band at the wrist and a tattooed back of the hand and fingers (03, 04).

tattoos.where: left lower shin / ankle and top of left foot
tattoos.description: Black geometric mandala band around the lower shin just above the ankle; bold black block lettering across the top of the left foot (reads like 'Ibiza')
Black lotus/mandala design on the top of the foot. There is no band around the right ankle.

kit.fight_shorts: Union Jack (red, white and blue) UFC shorts with crypto.com logo (UFC 321, Oct 2025); white Venum shorts with ASPINALL in red (2023)
kit.weigh_in: Dark olive-brown Venum shorts with yellow piping and a yellow graphic on the left leg (UFC 321 weigh-in)

morphs_if_available.note: Ear targets from the full MakeHuman set. They are not in the shipped assets/embed/mh-manifest.json, so they are listed here and not under morphs.

morphs_unavailable: Ears: the shipped assets/embed/mh-manifest.json has no ear targets, so the large protruding ears cannot be shown with morphs. Suggested full-set values (ear scale up, rotated forward as a stand-in for protrusion) are under morphs_if_available; otherwise sculpt or scale the ears. No target for hair, the goatee, or the very thick neck-to-jaw line beyond neck-scale-horiz.
notes: Confidence: medium-high for the overall look (very tall, thick neck, rectangular face, curly-top fade, goatee, light blue-grey eyes, protruding ears, neck/chest/arm tattoos); medium for exact morph values. What to watch for: (1) the neck and throat tattoos are new since 2023, so use the 2025 photos for them; (2) the goatee is narrow and pointed, and grew into a fuller jaw beard in 2026, so pick one style (default: the Oct 2025 goatee); (3) keep the eyes light blue-grey; dark eyes lose the likeness; (4) the body is big and slightly soft, not a shredded V-taper, so do not over-apply muscle; (5) macro/heightUpM uses a linear fit to the two MPFB2 builds in research/assets.md (height slider 0.30 -> 1.61 m, 0.62 -> 1.89 m, so slider = 0.5 + (H - 1.785 m) / 0.875 and heightUpM = 2 * (slider - 0.5)). Muscle and weight also change stature slightly, so measure the built mesh and nudge heightUpM until it matches the listed height. (6) he vacated the title in Sept 2026 after the eye injury, so do not render him with the belt by default. Review (second pass, 2026-11-06): re-checked every photo. Fixed the tattoo list: the mandala band is on the left ankle only (the right foot has a lotus and the left foot has lettering), the 2025 right sleeve is colour work (koi, skull/mask, peonies, black wrist band, tattooed hand), the left inner upper arm has a colour koi, and MCMXCIII sits at the base of the right side of the neck. The 2026 beard is a slightly wider goatee, not a jaw-line beard. Morph names and ranges validated against assets/embed/mh-manifest.json; values unchanged.

stance.source: Set 2026-11-06 from his documented fighting style: data/scouting/tom-aspinall.json (archetype, tags, signature and summary) and widely described stance traits. The ESPN stance cutouts (espn_stance_left.png, espn_stance_right.png) are posed standing shots, so they were used only for posture, shoulder set and build, not for the guard or footwork; fight footage would sharpen these values.
stance.notes: Light-footed for a heavyweight: athletic, fairly upright boxing stance with quick feints and level changes.
